messages:
Maya (People Ops): Sharing a micro-template for sprint-aligned goals and self-reviews. Use in 1:1s or hiring syncs. Format: Goal (1 line); 2 success signals; 1 dependency; 1 hiring note; 1 short ask.

Rina (Engineering Manager): Can you drop a quick infra example? Something we can paste into an issue.

Maya (People Ops): Infra example to paste:
Goal: Cut embed API p99 from ~420ms to <=320ms by quarter end.
Success signals: p99 < 350ms for 2 weeks; error rate < 0.1% 30d.
Dependency: KV cache rollout + perf tests.
HiringOps: 1 SWE (infra) 1 shortlist by 6/20.
Ask: Infra to confirm rollout window by 6/10.

Jon (PM): Love the hiring line. Can we also add a 2-sentence self-review prompt?

Maya (People Ops): Self-review prompt (pasteable):
1) One-sentence summary of impact.
2) Key metric or link as evidence.
3) One request for manager support.

people-ops-bot: Saved to Drive: https://drive.google.com/compact-goals. Pinning in #people-ops. :pushpin:
